scope: Seven existing week04 native management figures; exact caption locator guards
problem: A paragraph-bound management chart still rendered when its caption paragraph was missing; the reader fell back to unrelated activityJa. Activity-bound charts also rendered without their required activity. The selector previously checked only lesson ID/sourceHash.
reproductionBefore: Actual production FoodManagementVisuals regression failed: food-management-mean-range missing caption/revision must fail closed.
change: Require the exact supported caption locator to resolve to nonempty source text: activityJa or paragraphs.<existing ID> with nonempty title/body. Stale-revision matching remains unchanged. The reader now receives only figures with their own valid captions.
